# Getting Started

PRFlow is a Claude Code plugin for taking a GitHub issue through implementation, testing, review and documentation. It prepares the pull request; you retain final review and merge control.

Start in two steps:

1. [Install PRFlow](/docs/getting-started/installation) from its Claude Code plugin marketplace.
2. Follow the [first-run guide](/docs/getting-started/first-run) to initialize a repository, create an issue and implement it.

The local workflow works without cloud automation. When you are ready to run from GitHub comments, continue to [Cloud runs](/docs/runs/cloud/index).
